initial_gap: The existing preparation-record checker bound declared actas and rating times but did not open terminal or blinded objects, source or test output bytes, or replay a selection and redaction recipe.

local_contract.inputs: validated schema-2 private mapping, schema-1 actas named by raw SHA-256, and a caller-supplied directory of content-addressed <sha256>.bin blobs
local_contract.objects_rehashed: terminal artifact and trace, blinded package and trace, declarative replay profile, every declared source and test output
local_contract.replay_profile: fixed non-executable ordered-byte-spans-v1 marker; whole-input or canonical half-open byte spans, include or literal UTF-8 replacement, concatenate by output and step order
local_contract.source_test_condition: every declared source and test output contributes at least one nonempty included span to the blinded package; this does not prove complete-file availability to judges
local_contract.direct_identifier_screen: literal run ID, model ID, and model version patterns of at least eight UTF-8 bytes are checked in both blinded outputs; shorter identifiers are counted but not scanned
local_contract.limits: 432 records, 4096 distinct blobs, 64 MiB per blob and output, 128 MiB aggregate blobs and replayed output, 32 MiB aggregate actas

negative_controls: changed and swapped bytes under content-addressed filenames
missing source and test output blob
source or test output declared but no included span
malformed, out-of-range, zero-length, and noncanonical selectors
unsupported declarative replay profile or altered profile blob
replayed blinded package differing from authenticated bytes
literal long run, model, or version identifier in blinded package or trace
symlink, FIFO, hardlink, and extra blob entry
hardlinked acta and change between structural and byte passes
exact file read limit and changed file during descriptor read
bounded aggregate records, blobs, replay bytes, and identifier patterns

gates.note: The suite began before a limitation-text-only edit; the final focused gate below used the final implementation bytes.

gates.result: 50 passed in 2.24s on final implementation bytes

gates.command: ruff check scripts tests; ruff format --check scripts/verify_preparation_bytes.py tests/test_verify_preparation_bytes.py; git diff --check

independent_review.result: No fixed-file false green found for hash binding or byte replay; the review identified and closed unbounded aggregate memory/work, an undersized record-count cap, and false rejection from one-byte model versions.
independent_review.scoped_check: The multi-pattern identifier matcher agreed with direct substring search in 2000 random overlapping-pattern cases.
independent_review.remaining_limit: A digest of the replay profile does not authenticate the original transformer program or its execution.

limits: The synthetic actas, mapping, terminal receipts and ratings are under local control; external custody and the actual preparation or rating-lock chronology were not tested.
Including one nonempty span per source or test output does not demonstrate that judges received complete or separately verifiable files.
The direct identifier screen excludes strings shorter than eight bytes and cannot detect arm labels, paraphrases, metadata, style, or other semantic clues.
The snapshot can be changed after the final read by a writer with access to the supplied directories.
The fixed local memory caps may reject a larger valid candidate corpus; a streaming verifier is needed for that scale.
No model matrix, independent blinded evaluation, external custody, or confirmatory Q analysis was performed. Criterion 4 remains not assessed.
